[[File:Xbox-360-Consoles-Infobox.png|thumb|Xbox 360 Elite and Xbox 360 S consoles with controller]]
This is a list of video games for the [[Xbox 360]] [[video game console]] that have sold or shipped at least one million copies. The best-selling Xbox 360 game is ''[[Kinect Adventures!]]'', which was bundled with the [[Kinect]] accessory, selling 24 million units.

As of December 2009, over 353.8{{nbsp}}million total copies of games had been sold for the Xbox 360.<ref name="PSUnumbers">{{cite web|url=http://www.playstationuniversity.com/ps3-software-sales-outstrip-xbox-360s-ps3-attach-rate-up-to-8-1-3807|title=Xbox 360 YTD software sales|date=2009-12-31|access-date=2010-06-26|archive-date=2010-07-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100718015115/http://www.playstationuniversity.com/ps3-software-sales-outstrip-xbox-360s-ps3-attach-rate-up-to-8-1-3807/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
